summary: Verified all P1 economy extensions end-to-end. All 10 unit tests in test_economy_p1.py pass (auto_price helper, charter offered_goods Pydantic, caravan Pydantic + state machine). Full 67-test backend regression (test_economy.py + test_economy_p1.py + test_courtroom.py + test_law_jail_overhaul.py + test_t1_guard.py) green. Wrote a new 13-test live-API smoke suite (test_economy_p1_live_api.py) hitting the public ingress — all 13 pass. Confirmed via live curl that iron-ingots in astra-lun has import_price=50 (matching review's 40g base * 1.25 tariff cascade), so an auto-priced item with 30% markup correctly yields 65g retail. Auto-pricing wiring on POST /api/shops/{id}/items works end-to-end; refresh-price returns 400 for non-auto items; bulk refresh-prices returns the expected {updated, skipped, total_auto_priced} envelope; auto-priced item with no contract returns 400. Caravan lifecycle (post → claim → complete success) credits the claimer's wallet (net delta verified == 0 for same-user round-trip; debit on post + credit on complete cancels out). Cancel refunds the poster. Double-claim returns 400, cancel-on-completed returns 400, unauth POST returns 401/403, unknown good returns 400/404. Faction contracts list is public; URL/body slug mismatch returns 400. Charter with an invalid offered_good slug returns 400/404 BEFORE debit.
critical_code_review_comments: FACTION SLUG MISMATCH IN REVIEW: The review mentions 'fantasy-map-dev' as the faction used for live caravan testing but no such faction exists in the DB (only the 6 seeded ones: ardent-legion, forsaken-court, elderborn-alliance, forgemasters-guild, high-kings-court, loremasters-guild). My live tests use forgemasters-guild via admin bypass (admin/moderator role short-circuits _ensure_faction_leader). Main agent likely ran their live smoke against an ephemeral faction that was later cleaned up — not a code bug, but the test-doc should be updated.

Caravan completion fires WorldStateService.record_world_event in a try/except — good (best-effort). The economy hook downstream is also async fire-and-forget. No dedup, so a flapping success/fail toggle could fire repeated AI events — worth a debounce if user abuse becomes an issue, but no fix needed now.

ItemCreate model uses field name 'stock' (not 'quantity') for inventory count — frontend test should be aware. The review's payload examples imply 'quantity' which is the caravan field; don't conflate.

Charter offered_goods invalid-slug rejection returns 400 OR 404 depending on path — the test_economy_p1_live_api accepts both; consider standardising on 400 across the codebase for 'invalid catalogue reference' so the frontend can write a single error handler.

/api/economy/markets/{nation}/{city_slug} envelope returns {goods: [...]} on the live server (top-level dict); the existing test_economy_live_api flow already documents the unwrap pattern — keep consistent in any future endpoints.
